<documents>
<document id="close-inactivity">
InactiveˆaccountsˆWeˆmayˆcloseˆaccountsˆthatˆhaveˆaˆ$0.00ˆbalanceˆandˆnoˆactivityˆforˆ12ˆmonths.ˆ##ˆNoticeˆWeˆemailˆyouˆatˆleastˆ30ˆdaysˆbeforeˆclosing.ˆAnyˆactivityˆduringˆthatˆtime,ˆsuchˆasˆaˆdepositˆorˆaˆcardˆpurchase,ˆkeepsˆtheˆaccountˆopen.ˆ##ˆFeesˆWeˆdon'tˆchargeˆinactivityˆfeesˆ($0.00)ˆonˆanyˆplan.ˆ##ˆAccountsˆwithˆmoneyˆinˆthemˆWeˆdon'tˆcloseˆaccountsˆforˆinactivityˆwhileˆtheyˆholdˆaˆbalance,ˆincludingˆmoneyˆinˆSavingsˆPockets.ˆ##ˆPaidˆplansˆAˆpaidˆplanˆkeepsˆchargingˆitsˆmonthlyˆfeeˆwhileˆtheˆaccountˆisˆopen,ˆwhichˆcountsˆasˆactivity.ˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆuseˆyourˆaccount,ˆconsiderˆmovingˆtoˆBasic.ˆ##ˆComingˆbackˆIfˆyourˆaccountˆwasˆclosedˆforˆinactivity,ˆyouˆcanˆapplyˆforˆaˆnewˆoneˆwheneverˆyouˆlike.ˆ##ˆKeepingˆanˆaccountˆopenˆAnyˆcardˆpurchase,ˆdepositˆorˆtransferˆcountsˆasˆactivity.ˆSigningˆinˆtoˆtheˆappˆonˆitsˆownˆdoesn't.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="account-eligibility">
WhoˆcanˆopenˆanˆaccountˆYouˆcanˆopenˆaˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆifˆyou:ˆ-ˆAreˆatˆleastˆ18ˆyearsˆoldˆ-ˆLiveˆinˆtheˆUSˆandˆhaveˆaˆUSˆresidentialˆaddressˆ(notˆaˆPOˆbox)ˆ-ˆHaveˆaˆSocialˆSecurityˆnumberˆorˆITINˆ-ˆHaveˆanˆunexpiredˆgovernment-issuedˆphotoˆIDˆ-ˆHaveˆaˆsmartphoneˆthatˆcanˆrunˆtheˆTallowbrookˆappˆ##ˆOpeningˆanˆaccountˆDownloadˆtheˆappˆandˆtapˆGetˆstarted.ˆYou'llˆenterˆyourˆdetails,ˆtakeˆaˆphotoˆofˆyourˆIDˆandˆaˆselfie.ˆEveryˆaccountˆstartsˆonˆBasic,ˆandˆyouˆcanˆchangeˆplansˆonceˆyou'reˆverified.ˆ##ˆOneˆaccountˆperˆpersonˆEachˆpersonˆcanˆhaveˆoneˆTallowbrookˆaccount.ˆWeˆdon'tˆofferˆjointˆaccounts,ˆbusinessˆaccountsˆorˆaccountsˆforˆpeopleˆunderˆ18.ˆ##ˆLivingˆabroadˆIfˆyouˆmoveˆabroadˆpermanently,ˆyouˆmayˆneedˆtoˆcloseˆyourˆaccount.ˆTellˆusˆbeforeˆyouˆmove.ˆ##ˆPreviouslyˆclosedˆbyˆusˆIfˆTallowbrookˆclosedˆanˆaccountˆofˆyoursˆinˆtheˆpast,ˆaˆnewˆapplicationˆmayˆbeˆdeclined.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="docs-verification-letter">
AccountˆverificationˆletterˆAnˆaccountˆverificationˆletterˆconfirmsˆthatˆyouˆhaveˆanˆopenˆaccountˆwithˆus.ˆLandlords,ˆemployersˆandˆgovernmentˆofficesˆsometimesˆaskˆforˆone.ˆ##ˆGetˆaˆletterˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆDocuments,ˆthenˆAccountˆverificationˆletter.ˆTheˆPDFˆisˆreadyˆrightˆawayˆandˆshowsˆyourˆname,ˆaccountˆnumber,ˆaccountˆtypeˆandˆtheˆdateˆtheˆaccountˆwasˆopened.ˆ##ˆShowingˆyourˆbalanceˆYouˆcanˆchooseˆwhetherˆtheˆletterˆincludesˆyourˆcurrentˆbalance.ˆ##ˆCustomˆlettersˆWeˆcan'tˆwriteˆcustomˆletters,ˆsignˆforms,ˆorˆfillˆinˆthird-partyˆverificationˆforms.ˆTheˆstandardˆletterˆisˆacceptedˆbyˆmostˆorganizations.ˆ##ˆClosedˆaccountsˆLettersˆareˆonlyˆavailableˆforˆopenˆaccounts.ˆForˆaˆclosedˆaccount,ˆuseˆyourˆfinalˆstatement.ˆ##ˆSomeoneˆelseˆaskingˆWeˆdon'tˆconfirmˆaccountˆdetailsˆtoˆlandlords,ˆemployersˆorˆanyoneˆelseˆwhoˆcontactsˆusˆdirectly.ˆGiveˆthemˆtheˆletterˆyourself.ˆ##ˆIsˆitˆofficial?ˆYes.ˆTheˆletterˆcarriesˆaˆverificationˆcodeˆthatˆtheˆrecipientˆcanˆcheckˆonˆourˆhelpˆcenter.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: what do I need to open an account

response.text: {"answer":"To open a Tallowbrook account, you must be at least 18, live in the US with a residential address (not a PO box), have a Social Security number or ITIN, have an unexpired government-issued photo ID, and have a smartphone that can run the Tallowbrook app. Download the app and tap **Get started**; you’ll enter your details and take a photo of your ID and a selfie.
